# Hotel Prabhupada, Puri

> Hotel Prabhupada is a pet-friendly, sea-facing hotel on New Marine Drive Road near the lighthouse in Puri, Odisha, India. Its official website provides accommodation details, hotel facilities, reservations, guest policies, and local travel information.

Official website: https://www.hotelprabhupada.com/
Address: New Marine Drive Road, Near light house, Puri, Odisha 752001, India.
Reservations: +91 9583002952 / +91 9583002951.
Reservation email: reservation@hotelprabhupada.com.
Guest complaints email: gm@hotelprabhupada.com.
Last reviewed: 2026-09-16.

The hotel offers rooms for family, leisure, and pilgrimage stays in Puri. Facilities advertised on the website include an outdoor swimming pool, restaurant serving Odia and multi-cuisine food, conference hall, guest lounge, wellness services, and a lawn. Travel and temple darshan assistance are also advertised; arrangements should be confirmed with the hotel.

Room categories listed on the accommodation page:
- Premier Room.
- Deluxe Room with Balcony Sea View.
- Superior Deluxe Room with Balcony Side Sea View.
- Family Quad Sharing Room — No View.
- Executive Front Sea View Room — No Balcony.
- Suite Front Sea View Room — No Balcony.

Sea views and balconies depend on the booked room category; they are not features of every room. Standard check-in is 10:00 AM and check-out is 08:00 AM, local time in India. Early arrival and late departure require availability and may incur charges.

Pet stays are subject to the hotel's policy, room availability, documentation, fees, and restricted areas. Contact reservations before bringing a pet. Current prices, taxes, occupancy limits, meal inclusions, cancellation conditions, and availability must be checked for the selected dates and booking channel. This overview does not establish a room rate or guarantee a service. Where information differs between pages or a booking offer, confirm the applicable terms with reservations.
